notes: DQN / Double DQN grid search over StudentLife reward variants. Built-in metrics (td_error, action_match, value) computed on the val split; OPE (pdis, mood_improvement, direct_method_v0) computed on val with a behavior-cloning logging policy. Best config per variant = max PDIS. reward_sparse / reward_observed_only are NaN on most rows and filled with 0, so their PDIS can be near-degenerate.
